opening: Sarah Taylor Glasgow's original birth return records 8 September 1889 at Tamlaght and directly names Daniel Glasgow and Mary Jane formerly Boyd as her parents.

position.answer: Sarah was born on 8 September 1889, not 9 September; the next day's entry belongs to Elizabeth Boyd Glasgow.

evidence_questions.title: Why is Sarah's birth date 8 September?
evidence_questions.answer: Entry 370 on the original register page reads 8 September 1889; Elizabeth's separate entry 371 reads 9 September.
evidence_questions.reasoning: The two consecutive original entries distinguish the dates and both name the same parents and Tamlaght place.
evidence_questions.limitation: This corrects Sarah's date only; it does not decide how the consecutive-day births should be medically described.
evidence_questions.missing: No further source is needed for the registered date.

birth-sarah-glasgow-1889.recorded_statement: Entry 370 records Sarah Taylor Glasgow at Tamlaght on 8 September 1889.
birth-sarah-glasgow-1889.relevance: Direct registered birth date and parent statement.
birth-sarah-glasgow-1889.limitation: The return records Daniel's residence as New York but does not identify his later US record.
